# Alamy

> Alamy is a stock media marketplace for discovering, licensing, and selling photos, vectors, illustrations, and video.

Alamy serves creative, editorial, and commercial customers with a large global collection of licensable visual content, while also providing contributor tools, enterprise services, and support resources for photographers, agencies, and media buyers.

## Search & Browse
- [Stock Photos, Images and Vectors](https://www.alamy.com/stock-photo/): Browse Alamy’s main catalog of licensable stock photography, illustrations, and vector imagery.
- [Stock Videos and Footage](https://www.alamy.com/stock-video/): Explore royalty-managed and stock footage collections for commercial and editorial projects.
- [Live News](https://www.alamy.com/news/): Access current editorial imagery covering breaking news, sport, and entertainment.
- [Fresh Picks](https://www.alamy.com/fresh-picks): Discover curated image selections and themed collections chosen by Alamy editors.
- [Image Categories](https://www.alamy.com/categories/): Browse stock content by subject, theme, and visual category.
- [Search Results](https://www.alamy.com/search.html): Search across Alamy’s marketplace for images, vectors, and other media assets.

## Licensing & Business Services
- [Licensing Options](https://www.alamy.com/licensing-and-pricing/): Learn about Alamy licensing models, pricing, and usage options for creative and editorial content.
- [Rights Managed](https://www.alamy.com/rights-managed/): Overview of rights-managed licensing for controlled, usage-specific image purchases.
- [Royalty Free](https://www.alamy.com/royalty-free/): Overview of royalty-free licensing for flexible reuse across approved projects.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.alamy.com/solutions/): Explore business services for publishers, agencies, and teams needing scalable content access.
- [AI Training Media](https://www.alamy.com/ai-training-media): Source ethically licensed visual datasets for machine learning and AI training use cases.

## Contributors
- [Contributors](https://www.alamy.com/contributor): Main contributor area for photographers, videographers, and agencies selling content on Alamy.
- [Upload Images](https://www.alamy.com/contributor/upload-images): Upload still images for review and licensing through the contributor platform.
- [Upload Video](https://www.alamy.com/contributor/upload-video): Submit stock footage and video clips for sale on Alamy.
- [Contributor Dashboard](https://www.alamy.com/contributor/dashboard): Manage submissions, sales activity, account details, and contributor performance.
- [Contributor Help](https://www.alamy.com/contributor/help): Find contributor-specific guidance on uploading, keywording, payments, and policies.
- [Sell Your Images](https://www.alamy.com/sell-stock-photos/): Learn how photographers and creators can earn revenue by licensing work on Alamy.

## Help & Support
- [Help Center](https://www.alamy.com/help): Central support hub for customers and contributors using Alamy.
- [Customer FAQs](https://www.alamy.com/help/customer): Get answers about buying, downloading, licensing, and account management.
- [Contributor FAQs](https://www.alamy.com/help/contributor): Find support articles for submissions, QC, releases, and contributor payments.
- [Contact Us](https://www.alamy.com/contact-us/): Reach Alamy support for sales, licensing, contributor, and general inquiries.

## Blog & Learning
- [Alamy Blog](https://www.alamy.com/blog/): Read articles on stock media trends, photography, visual culture, and contributor advice.
- [Photography Tips](https://www.alamy.com/blog/category/photography-tips/): Learn practical shooting, editing, and submission advice for stock photographers.
- [Contributor News](https://www.alamy.com/blog/category/contributor-news/): Stay updated on platform changes, contributor programs, and selling guidance.
- [Creative Trends](https://www.alamy.com/blog/category/creative-trends/): Explore visual trends and ideas relevant to designers, marketers, and publishers.

## Account & Purchasing
- [Sign In](https://www.alamy.com/signin/): Access your Alamy customer or contributor account.
- [Register](https://www.alamy.com/register/): Create a new account to buy content or start contributing.
- [Lightboxes](https://www.alamy.com/lightboxes/): Save, organize, and share selected images for later review or purchase.
- [Cart](https://www.alamy.com/cart/): Review selected assets and proceed to licensing and checkout.

- [Press](https://www.alamy.com/press/): Find company announcements, media information, and press resources.
